centralVias.note: Native through-via; no filled/capped process established.

openQuestions: Choose stencil thickness and paste using measured print/reflow results.
Review solder wicking/voiding at the central through-via; mask tenting is not filling/capping.
Do not simply delete the via: via-removal-experiment.json records a native connectivity regression.
Establish hidden-pad inspection and rework capability; a working UART alone does not inspect the pad.

firstArticleProcessCandidate.bottom: Reflow the 24 bottom-side parts once with the component side up, subject to every part/paste thermal limits.
firstArticleProcessCandidate.top: Then hand-solder the eight accessible switches, SOT-25 LDO and two capacitors with local heat; verify access on a dry fit.
firstArticleProcessCandidate.benefit: Avoids requiring a second full-board reflow and inverted heavy socket retention for a one-off build.
firstArticleProcessCandidate.notYetProven: Operator/equipment, socket heat limits, USB shell solder fill and actual print/reflow profile.
